Every other row in that prior map is UNCHANGED by this workstream and is not restated in full here; this document is additive, not a replacement.

changedRow.priorOwner: NONE, DURABLY (docs/phase-3f1-6-r-blocker-remediation/19-contract-truth-ownership-map.json's own disclosed finding - IRRule/IRDefinition existed only in-memory for one runContractAnalysis call).

hierarchyStatement.authoritative_for_current_verified_truth: SemanticTruthRecord rows with trustStatus = VERIFIED, read via lib/contract-model/analysis/semantic-truth/service.ts's getTrustedSemanticTruth - the ONE function any downstream reader of 'current, trusted semantic contract truth' should call.
hierarchyStatement.available_for_audit_but_never_promoted: SemanticTruthRecord rows with trustStatus in {COMPILED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, CONTRADICTED, UNSUPPORTED} - readable via getAllSemanticTruthForInstrument for audit/review UIs, but MECHANICALLY distinct from the trusted read path (a different function, a different WHERE clause) so a caller cannot accidentally treat unverified state as trusted by calling the wrong function - there is no single 'get everything, then filter yourself' function that a careless caller could misuse.
hierarchyStatement.legacy_pipeline_remains_separate_and_sub: lib/extraction/** (ExtractionCandidate -> DefinedTerm/ContractRule via lib/onboarding/promotion.ts's promoteApprovedCandidate) remains its OWN, separate, valid workflow for human-reviewed candidate suggestions and Phase-B-shaped compatibility artifacts. It is NOT capable of overriding SemanticTruthRecord: the two pipelines share no identity/key space (ContractRule.stableKey vs. SemanticTruthRecord's own (companyId, instrumentKey, kind, semanticObjectId) key are unrelated, independently-derived identifiers, confirmed by direct field-by-field comparison in 09-semantic-truth-persistence-design.json's own legacyModelShapeComparison), no code path in either direction reads one table and writes the other, and no compatibility adapter was built (none was needed - the prior BLOCKER-10 phase's own investigation, re-confirmed here, found the two pipelines' real outputs do not overlap in any of the examined truth kinds).
hierarchyStatement.review_state_still_two_separate_models_b: CandidateReviewEvent/ExtractionCandidate.reviewStatus (legacy: 'did a human approve this AI-proposed FACT') and ClaimReviewItem (contract-model: 'does the PIPELINE ITSELF believe this claim needs a human to look at') remain intentionally unreconciled, per the prior BLOCKER-10 phase's own correct finding - this workstream adds a THIRD, related-but-distinct concept (SemanticTruthTrustStatus - 'has this compiled representation been independently verified') that answers yet another different question and does not collapse into either existing review-state model.
